attr.title: Five Nights at Freddy's 3
attr.desc: Thirty years after Freddy Fazbear's Pizza closed its doors, the events that took place there have become nothing more than a rumor and a childhood memory, but the owners of "Fazbear's Fright: The Horror Attraction" are determined to revive the legend and make the experience as authentic as possible for patrons, going to great lengths to find anything that might have survived decades of neglect and ruin.
attr.inst: Downloads the latest version of the game on steam and place the FiveNightsatFreddys3.exe into fnaf3/gamedata
